description: Search the web for information. Returns up to 5 results by default with titles, URLs, and descriptions. The query is passed through to the configured backend, so operators such as site:domain, filetype:pdf, intitle:word, -term, and "exact phrase" may work when the backend supports them.
name: web_search

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: The search query to look up on the web. You may include backend-supported operators such as site:example.com, filetype:pdf, intitle:word, -term, or "exact phrase".

stakes.description: Optional. standard: low-stakes lookups where some error is cheap (docs, APIs, product specs, how-tos, recipes, navigation, background); may use a cheaper search tier. Omit or pass high for legal, financial, tax, medical, compliance, official sources, news, prices, safety, time-sensitive or costly-if-wrong work. When unsure, omit.
